newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco to cut power rates in June.
newsitem.headline: Meralco to cut power rates in June.

text.p: The Manila Electric Co (Meralco) will reduce power rates for its commercial and industrial customers in June, a company official said on Saturday.
Rates of commercial and industrial customers with daily load requirements of two megawatts and above will be lowered by 18 centavos per kilowatt-hour (kwh), a Meralco official said.
Power rates for commercial and industrial customers with consumption of less than two megawatts will be cut by 12 centavos per kwh.
Meralco currently charges commercial establishments 3.10 pesos per kwh and industry 2.90 pesos.
The official said the cuts would be part of a 4.82 centavo per kwh rate reduction requested by the National Power Corp (Napocor) and approved by the Energy Regulatory Board on Friday.
Meralco is the biggest electricity distributor in the Philippines and Napocor's largest customer.
The company source said the reduction will be passed on solely to commercial and industrial customers since they have been subsidising residential consumers. ($1 = 26.3 pesos)
